tour.welcome.title: Welcome to ReduxShare!
tour.welcome.text: This is a demo Moodle page with real questions. Everything works for real and the network is mocked — nobody sees your clicks. Take a short tour to see what the extension can do.
tour.rWidget.title: The R button next to every answer
tour.rWidget.text: An R button appears next to every answer option. Click it to open a menu with all known answers. The R hotkey can be changed in the popup.
tour.menu.title: Answer menu
tour.menu.text: The Internal tab shows the exact answer and statistics, External — answers from the external database, AI — a neural network request. Click an option to fill it into the page.
tour.stats.title: Statistics and voting
tour.stats.text: The Statistics item lists every option entered by other users with 👍/👎 votes. Dubious answers are marked amber. Cast your vote too — it makes the database sharper.
tour.ai.title: AI assistant
tour.ai.text: In the AI tab, Send request solves the question and Explain answer walks you through the solution. Apply an answer with a click. Your provider key is configured in the popup AI tab.
tour.essay.title: Essays: community examples
tour.essay.text: For essays ReduxShare shows the best example answers — insert and edit them. Your own answer can be saved as an example for others, and you can vote for the ones you like.
tour.autoSelect.title: Auto-fill and humanization
tour.autoSelect.text: ReduxShare can select correct answers by itself — with adjustable tempo and humanization: reading imitation, delays and click order look natural.
tour.statusPanel.title: Attempt status panel
tour.statusPanel.text: The panel shows progress and time. The settings tray holds copy unlocking and auto-pass start/stop with a pause on hard questions.
tour.preview.title: Question preview
tour.preview.text: During the tour, a popup opens with every question and answer before the attempt starts — from the shared database or an external source (with an ID scan).
tour.import.title: Import after submission
tour.import.text: After you submit a quiz, ReduxShare silently imports your answers from the review page into the shared database — even if you never pressed anything. The popup shows how many questions you have contributed.
tour.popup.title: Extension popup
tour.popup.text: Clicking the extension icon opens the popup: sign-in and statistics, auto-fill basics, appearance, security (stealth mode and copy unlock), AI and servers.
tour.finish.title: All done!
tour.finish.text: That is everything it can do. On a real Moodle page it works the same — open any quiz and enjoy.
tour.toast.navigationBlocked: This is a demo: navigation is disabled during the tour
tour.finished.title: Tour finished!
tour.finished.text: Now you know how ReduxShare works on a real Moodle page.
